commands.summary: 5/5 runtime tests passed: strict QueryView contract, conjunction of capability and certificate, single reference forward on miss, atomic commit fail-closed on non-finite, expiration and cooldown, recording boundary reset, and gate closed profile
All 309/309 tests passed across entire test suite
Verified 214/214 protected files clean and intact

requirement_evidence.evidence: StreamingRuntimeExecutor accepts only QueryView instances and rejects non-QueryView objects with InvalidQueryError. Uses only observable window coordinates without future leakage or labels. Verified by test_c01_queryview_input_contract_and_nonfinite_rejection.

Formal reuse requires conjunction of formal_reuse_enabled (cleared by numerical capability gate), active certificate validity, identity match, and validated domain membership. Verified by test_c02_and_c03_miss_single_forward_and_atomic_issuance.

On miss or fallback, reference.infer() is called exactly once (build_attempts == 1, forward executed once). TrustedAnchorReceipt is issued and verified before building a certificate. Rejects arbitrary caller logits. Verified by test_c02_and_c03_miss_single_forward_and_atomic_issuance.

Atomic state commit occurs only after successful output; non-finite inputs raise ValueError in QueryView and leave executor state completely uncommitted. Verified by test_c01_queryview_input_contract_and_nonfinite_rejection.

RuntimeCounters tracks total_queries, reused_certified_count, fallback_reference_count, fallback_non_member_count, fallback_expired_count, fallback_recording_reset_count, fallback_gate_closed_count, fallback_unsupported_count, build_attempts, build_successes, build_failures, and latency. Verified by test_c05_and_c06_expiration_and_cooldown.

Certificates expire strictly after anchor_step + max_age. Cooldown prevents continuous failed re-build attempts. Parameters are fixed from configuration, not tuned by online ground truth. Verified by test_c05_and_c06_expiration_and_cooldown.

Replay stream validation achieves 100% decision agreement with reference full forward on all queries. Recording stream resets atomically invalidate certificates. Gate-closed profile forces 100% fallback to reference model (0 reuse). Verified by test_c07_recording_boundary_reset_and_gate_closed_profile and test_c07_validation_ablation_and_artifact.

scientific_dispositions.H03_zero_lookahead: CONFIRMED: QueryView contract strictly binds observable window inputs; no future prediction or label leakage.
scientific_dispositions.H05_fallbacks_safe: CONFIRMED: Trusted fallback on miss guarantees 100.0% agreement with reference model full forward inference.
scientific_dispositions.H15_fixed_anchor: CONFIRMED: Immutability enforced; anchor coordinates and bounding boxes remain fixed during certificate reuse hits.
scientific_dispositions.H16_expiration_enforced: CONFIRMED: Certificates expire deterministically upon reaching anchor_step + max_age.
scientific_dispositions.H18_finite_horizon: CONFIRMED: Atomic state commit and fail-closed error handling ensure consistent runtime state.

limitations: Current runtime validation uses diagonal coordinate boxes; correlated PCA domains from W4-016 will be integrated in downstream benchmark tasks W4-025/W4-027.
Streaming reuse rate with coordinate boxes on raw sensor windows is low (near 0%) as expected from H08/H10 without domain expansion.
